_note: Copy this whole instances/_template/ folder to instances/<your-client-id>/ and fill in every field below. <your-client-id> is what you set as the INSTANCE env var for that deployment.
name: Client Business Name
_recommendedAgentsNote: recommendedAgents is what the onboarding wizard's review screen (server/onboarding.js's VERTICAL_RECOMMENDED_AGENTS) pre-checks for a given vertical before the owner activates a client — copy the list it picked here for your records, or set it by hand when hand-provisioning without the wizard. It becomes this file's own 'agents' field (server/brain.js's activation-set fallback — see server/catalog.js) once you decide the real starting roster; leave 'agents' out entirely for 'everything active', the original default.
_vapiNote: Optional — only read when VAPI_ASSISTANT_REQUEST=1 on this deployment (server/vapiAssistant.js). Every field below falls back to the default shown if this whole 'vapi' block, or any field inside it, is left out entirely.

vapi.firstMessage: Thanks for calling <business name> — how can I help?
